entries.speaker: Chaînés Hook
entries.en: After the lessons with Kasumi,[n][fName] can now use [clr 1]Chaînés Hook[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Chaînés Hook
entries.en: Using your grappling hook will enable you[n]to attack a Shadow that is slightly further[n]away than usual and start a preemptive battle.

entries.speaker: Chaînés Hook
entries.en: When you start a battle with your Chaînés Hook,[n]the enemies will begin the fight inflicted with[n]Dizzy, Confuse, or Fear.
